description: Reliability PR 5's action fixtures, written without reference to `eval/jev/actions.json`: twelve per decision point (`work.start`, `specs.check`, `loop.fix`), six calibration and six held out, split by the SHA-256 of the fixture id within each label. Each carries the fields `compare.offered_and_state` reads at its point and the candidate a careful operator would pick: a spec that names its change is dispatched, one that depends on a rule or decision it does not cite gathers evidence first, a goal with no acceptance criterion of its own asks (`clarify`, offered only then); a check is chosen when it examines the changed files; a finding that rests on a rule or decision, or was disputed the round before, gathers context.

r1.note: Not reviewed yet; decision results on these labels are provisional.

done: tests/test_window.py has a test that passes '' to parse_window() and expects ValueError

done: the 'segment skipped' line in src/compactor.py logs at warning

done: no reference to fmt_bytes remains under src/

spec.goal: Change how the archive writer stores timestamps in batch headers
done: batch headers written by src/writer.py carry the new timestamp field

spec.goal: Add a retry to the upload client's network calls
Store user sessions for the new admin console
done: the admin console keeps a session across two requests

spec.goal: Add pagination to the GET /batches endpoint
done: GET /batches returns a next-page marker when more batches exist

spec.goal: Handle errors properly in the export job
